description: A ginger-and-white cat and a tabby cat sit side by side on a dark polished tiled hallway floor, looking up at the camera. A tall white metal safety gate blocks the doorway behind them. The ginger cat walks up to the gate and slips between its bars into the dark room beyond. The tabby then crosses to a small square cat flap set low in the white wall next to the gate, pushes its head through and squeezes its whole body out, until only its striped tail is left in the hallway.

en.question: What is the grey cat doing?

de.answer: Sie geht durch eine kleine Tür.
de.question: Was macht die graue Katze?

es.answer: Está pasando por una puerta pequeña.
phrases: saltar por encima de la barrera
